subject: Signal and System
questionText:
A CT system has the input output relationship
y(t) = x(5t). The system is
 (a)
static, linear and time-variant
(b)
dynamic, linear and time-variant
(c)
dynamic, linear and time-invariant
(d)
static, linear and time-invariant
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-07 (Types of System).
